---
title: "6 · Generative Models: Variational and Conditional Autoencoders"
code-tools: false
toc: false
---

Learning a probability distribution: likelihood and maximum likelihood, the variational autoencoder, the evidence lower bound as a variational free energy, and the reparametrisation trick. Synthetic data judged by classifiers trained on real data. The conditional VAE generates digits on demand. Generated spins and the Hamiltonian: conditional VAEs for the 2D Ising and the J1–J2 model reproduce the phase, the order parameter and the phase diagram at unseen parameters, but not the energy and its fluctuations.
